Photography isn’t just a hobby — it’s a revolution. And here at This Week in Photo, we’re not here to tiptoe around it.

I’m Frederick Van Johnson, and every week I go beyond the hype, peeling back the marketing gloss to uncover what’s actually driving the future of photography. From AI image-making to creative breakthroughs, gear you should (or shouldn’t) buy, and real stories from photographers in the trenches — we dig into it all.

If you’re tired of the same old “top 5 lenses” videos, and you actually want to think, laugh, and level up your creative game… welcome home.

🛠️ Interviews with real pros (not influencers)
🛠️ Unfiltered discussions on tech, business, and the craft
🛠️ Photo critiques, challenges, and community engagement
🛠️ A fearless look at the future of visual storytelling

👊 Hit subscribe. Step up. Let’s change the frame.

🔗 More at ThisWeekinPhoto.com
